Order No.04/Dated- 07.10.2025 I.A. No.12613 of 2025
1.

Heard Mr. Birendra Kumar, learned counsel for the appellant and Mr. S.K. Srivastava, learned A.P.P.
2.
This application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail to him during the pendency of this appeal.

3. The appellant has been convicted for the offences under Sections 302/34 and 376(D)/34 of the Indian Penal Code and has been sentenced to undergo imprisonment for life along with fine of Rs.30,000/- for the offence under Section 302/34 of the I.P.C. and rigorous imprisonment for 20 years along with fine of Rs.30,000/- for the offence under Section 376(D)/34 of the I.P.C.
4.
It has been alleged that the mother of the informant had gone to graze goats but when she did not return, a search was conducted and the dead body was subsequently found.

5. Submission has been advanced by learned counsel for the appellant that the First Information Report was instituted against unknown and even in her 161 Cr.P.C. statement, informant had not Dhansingh Pahan @ Dhansingh Munda @ ... vs The State Of Jharkhand on 7 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49580170/
1 taken the name of the appellant.

sentences.text: Learned counsel adds that there has been an exaggeration in the evidence of the informant who has been examined as P.W.2 as subsequently, she has taken the name of the present appellant as having committed the murder of her mother.

Learned counsel adds that the confessional statement of the appellant was recorded but the same did not lead to recovery of any incriminating articles to connect the appellant with the present murder.
Learned counsel further submits that the appellant is in custody since 31.07.2019.
6. Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the appellant.
7. Regard being had to the dearth of evidence collected by the prosecution and the improvements made by the informant in her evidence as P.W.2, we are inclined to admit the appellant on bail.

Accordingly, during the pendency of this appeal, the appellant namely Dhansingh Pahan @
Dhansingh Munda @ Pahan is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/-
(Rupees Ten Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Additional Judicial Commissioner-XX, Civil Court Ranchi in S.T. No.43 of 2020 arising out of Tamar P.S. Case No.55 of 2019.
8. I.A. No.12613 of 2025 is allowed accordingly.
